_meta.notes: Later form face with both an 'Office' box (left blank) and an 'Office Sought' box ('Council' / district 'At Large'), and a 'FINAL / DISSOLUTION REPORT' block; Column B is headed 'Aggregate Total' and is blank on both lines. Year-End box checked, neither amendment box checked; signed 2-1-10 and clerk-stamped RECEIVED FEB 01 2010, i.e. the year-end report FOR 2009. Summary Page header 'Horiuchi, Feb. 1/10' (the page/of box is blank). Cents are written as raised superscripts. Arithmetic exact (26,812.84 + 9,060.00 = 35,872.84; less 7,760.26 = 28,112.58), and the closing balance chains correctly into the 2010 year-end report (key 7165730e).

contributions.detail: exact (42 rows sum 9060.00 = the attachment's own printed grand total $9,060.00 at the foot of p4 = stated 9,060.00 = Summary lines 1 and 4). p3 carries 29 rows summing 5735.00 and p4 carries 13 rows summing 3325.00

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: Neither attachment is the county form, so neither prints 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE'. p3 has NO total of its own (the Schedule A spreadsheet runs onto p4 and prints one grand total there) - so no gate fires on p3 alone; the gate used for the contribution side is the single printed grand total $9,060.00 against all 42 rows across p3+p4, which PASSES. p5 rows sum 7760.26 = the attachment's own printed total 7,760.26 GATE PASS.
itemized.escalation_note: p3 and p4 re-rendered at 600 dpi and rotated 90 deg CCW, then the Last/First name column read as four tight bands (all names identical on re-read, and 'Jackie Biskuoski Campaign' / 'Suite' confirmed as printed rather than corrected to the real-world spellings); p5 expenditure rows read as two 400 dpi bands
itemized.notes: Randy Horiuchi, Council At Large, Year-End Report January 31 (signed 2-1-10, clerk stamp FEB 01 2010). The two schedules are NOT the county form: Schedule A is a typed LANDSCAPE spreadsheet spanning PDF pages 3-4 (rendered portrait by poppler and read after a 90 deg counter-clockwise rotation; geometry has been converted back to portrait page percentages) and Schedule B is a typed PORTRAIT table on p5. TWO STRUCTURAL PROPERTIES OF THE SCHEDULE A ATTACHMENT: (1) it has NO DATE COLUMN AT ALL - its columns are Last, First, Address, City, State, Zip, Occupation and Employer, Contributed - so no contribution row can carry a date, and every date is blank by source non-existence, not by illegibility; (2) its Address column is covered by a solid WHITE county REDACTION block on every row, while the separate City and State columns survive, so donor_city/donor_state ARE recorded (the block hides only the street line). The sheet also carries a Zip column, which has no schema field and was deliberately not recorded. Its header box reads 'Page: 1 Of: 1' even though the sheet actually runs onto a second page. Two printed names are filer spellings that differ from the real-world ones and are kept EXACTLY as printed: 'Jackie Biskuoski Campaign' (Biskupski) and 'Suite, Steven' - both re-read at 600 dpi. Schedule B's 11/17/2009 Jeff Gilbert row has an EMPTY Purpose cell. Balance chain closes on the Summary Page: 26,812.84 + 9,060.00 = 35,872.84; 35,872.84 - 7,760.26 = 28,112.58.
